My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd),

Could you be so kind as first to send on a card the name of anyone to write to at Freshwater about lodgings for a fortnight or so, or if that great Alum bay hotel is thought well of.<sup>1</sup> [Mrs Elgie](people/person_474.qmd)<sup>2</sup> wants a little airing after her winter of illness, and I fancy Bonchurch would be too relaxing for her, but if there are any lodgings anywhere you specially recommend it would be a kindness to mention them, and the sort of rate of price.

It is only [Mr](people/person_478.qmd) and Mrs Elgie, not the children. If you are gone from home, perhaps one of your sisters would be so kind as to set down particulars.

Yours sincerely,

C M Yonge
